title: Fixed Pinched Segment Balloon Dog
description: One newly authored whole static balloon-dog-style toy sculpture. Four lower leg ends have finite flat display soles. Every visible shape is new rather than recolouring a biological rabbit or replacing a wooden rocking-horse material: there is no carved animal torso, seated haunch, saddle, handle, runner, eye or fur. Separate closed solids with intentional concealed embeddings show one fixed knot arrangement; they are not an actual single continuous inflated tube. Two opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up, horizontal-envelope-centred. One toy model, zero scenes.
